label: Total water storage incl. groundwater (GRACE/GRACE-FO)
verdict: Total water storage incl. groundwater (GRACE/GRACE-FO) (all months, 2003-2026): the trend is +10.0 cm per decade, about +23.0 cm over the whole period. It is NOT statistically significant: p = 0.255 >= 0.05. That does not prove there is no trend; the change is not distinguishable from year-to-year variability with this many years. A longer record or a larger region can make a real trend significant. Neighbouring years are correlated (carry-over r = 0.90), so the test counts about 3 independent years instead of 22; ignoring that would overstate significance.
